entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We disembarked in front of Palas Re..."
entries.dialogueText: We disembarked in front of Palas Rezna. It was time for the reception.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The day of Vina's wedding had final..."
entries.dialogueText: The day of Vina's wedding had finally arrived.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The mood in the country was jubilan..."
entries.dialogueText: The mood in the country was jubilant, buoyed even further by our recent successes in the Pales war.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The mood in the country was jubilan..."
entries.dialogueText: The mood in the country was jubilant, though our recent setbacks in the Pales war lent solemn undertones to the celebrations.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The mood in the country was jubilan..."
entries.dialogueText: The mood in the country was jubilant, buoyed even further by the imminent return of Zille.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The mood in the country was jubilan..."
entries.dialogueText: The mood in the country was jubilant, though the prospect of permanently losing Zille to Wehlen lent solemn undertones to the celebrations.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My own mood, however, was pitch-bla..."
entries.dialogueText: My own mood, however, was pitch-black. Though the entire country had been combed overnight, there was still no sign of my daughter.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was time to face the facts. The..."
entries.dialogueText: It was time to face the facts. The royal wedding was off.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Citizens waved Rizian and Palesian..."
entries.dialogueText: Citizens waved Rizian and Palesian flags from their balconies as our carriage procession wound through the streets of Porte Drazon, flanked by the Golden Guard.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Citizens waved Rizian flags and Hou..."
entries.dialogueText: Citizens waved Rizian flags and House Toras crests from their balconies as our carriage procession wound through the streets of Porte Drazon, flanked by the Golden Guard and members of Su Omina.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The service had just concluded at t..."
entries.dialogueText: The service had just concluded at the Archsanctuary of Zilba.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina had been nervous as we walked..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina had been nervous as we walked down the aisle together. But the moment she spotted Duke Reinhart waiting for her at the altar, it all melted away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina had squeezed my arm tightly as..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina had squeezed my arm tightly as we walked down the aisle together. When she saw Manus waiting for her at the altar, she cried tears of joy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina had refused to take my arm as..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina had refused to take my arm as we walked down the aisle together. She had a determined steeliness in her eyes as she joined Rico at the altar.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In Sal's absence, I presided over t..."
entries.dialogueText: In Sal's absence, I presided over the wedding myself, repeating the words I'd said to Lucita just the night before.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius presided ove..."
entries.dialogueText: Grand Wiseman Ignacius presided over the wedding, giving no sign that he'd repeated the same words to myself and Lucita the night before.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius presided ove..."
entries.dialogueText: Grand Wiseman Ignacius presided over the wedding, reciting the traditional words from an ancient scroll.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In Sal's absence, I presided over t..."
entries.dialogueText: In Sal's absence, I presided over the wedding myself, reciting the traditional words from an ancient scroll.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As per tradition, the newlyweds sha..."
entries.dialogueText: As per tradition, the newlyweds shared their first kiss on the Zilba steps in front of the public. The crowd went wild as Axel dipped Vina low for the cameras.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was traditional for the newlywed..."
entries.dialogueText: It was traditional for the newlyweds to kiss on the Zilba steps, but due to concerns about the ongoing violent protests in Rizia Imperii, the entire wedding party was ushered out the back door instead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As per tradition, the newlyweds sha..."
entries.dialogueText: As per tradition, the newlyweds shared their first kiss on the Zilba steps in front of the public. Neither paid attention to the cheering throngs as they passionately locked lips.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As per tradition, the newlyweds sha..."
entries.dialogueText: As per tradition, the newlyweds shared their first kiss on the Zilba steps in front of the public. It was little more than a polite peck, each of them studiously avoiding eye contact with the other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Flanked by the Golden Guard, an arm..."
entries.dialogueText: Flanked by the Golden Guard, an armored car drove us through cleared-out streets until we reached Palas Rezna. It was time for the reception.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita was by my side as we entered..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita was by my side as we entered the Grand Hall. I heard cheers mixed with disapproving whispers as the photographers took our picture.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel was by my side as we entered..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel was by my side as we entered the Grand Hall. I heard a few disapproving whispers as the photographers took our picture.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was an undeniable spark betwe..."
entries.dialogueText: There was an undeniable spark between them. It wasn't love yet, but it could be.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sensed they'd grown closer in Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: I sensed they'd grown closer in Pales than Vina had wanted to admit. Perhaps they'd even fallen in love.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Queen Mother was by my side as..."
entries.dialogueText: The Queen Mother was by my side as we entered the Grand Hall. She was wearing a deep violet hat that resembled a fanciful undersea creature. I heard a few giggles as the photographers took our picture.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I shouldn't have taken you up on t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shouldn't have taken you up on that wedding date offer. Aside from the unwelcome attention, I wonder if anyone else bothered to do a last-minute quality check on the wine."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Was this a mistake? Too much, too..."
entries.dialogueText: "Was this a mistake? Too much, too quickly?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Remember to smile, darling. It's y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember to smile, darling. It's your daughter's wedding day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I *am* smiling. It fills me with j..."
entries.dialogueText: "I *am* smiling. It fills me with joy to see Vina wed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're still at war. I've got to lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're still at war. I've got to look solemn and determined."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's more than that. It's the hist..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's more than that. It's the historic reunion between Rizia and Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm happy for the two of them. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy for the two of them. But I'm nervous about the fallout from the other houses."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To her cousin. Not exactly anyone'..."
entries.dialogueText: "To her cousin. Not exactly anyone's dream scenario."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Nonsense. Did you see your uncle's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonsense. Did you see your uncle's face during the ceremony? Over the moon."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Worry about that after dinner.""
entries.dialogueText: "Worry about that after dinner."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""All the more reason for jubilation.""
entries.dialogueText: "All the more reason for jubilation."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Nonsense. You need a break. The ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonsense. You need a break. The kingdom needs a break."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Then show it. The world is watchin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then show it. The world is watching."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm trying to smile, but I keep ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm trying to smile, but I keep getting distracted by that sea monster on your head."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Don't be such a philistine. They'l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be such a philistine. They'll hang it in a museum someday."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Relax. That's what the wedding com..."
entries.dialogueText: "Relax. That's what the wedding committee is for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're a lord now. Such menial tas..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a lord now. Such menial tasks no longer concern you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps it was rather careless of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps it was rather careless of me to upstage Vina on her big day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing to be done about it now. Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing to be done about it now. Your job is to be my arm candy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. For all anyone knows,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. For all anyone knows, we're just good friends."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel adjusted his bow tie and made..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel adjusted his bow tie and made an effort to smile for the cameras.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sure."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""We've made our bed, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "We've made our bed, Your Majesty. Time to lie in it."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You're right.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry about that. Focus on b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about that. Focus on being my arm candy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We crossed the room and took our pl..."
entries.dialogueText: We crossed the room and took our place behind the head table. My mother was already seated, wearing a deep violet hat that resembled a fanciful undersea creature.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It hasn't even been 24 hours. Give..."
entries.dialogueText: "It hasn't even been 24 hours. Give me time to get into the noble mindset."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""As Your Majesty commands.""
entries.dialogueText: "As Your Majesty commands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That wasn't your attitude last nig..."
entries.dialogueText: "That wasn't your attitude last night, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps it was rather careless of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps it was rather careless of me to upstage Vina on her big day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course not. Today shall serve a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course not. Today shall serve as two wedding celebrations in one."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Shh.""
entries.dialogueText: "Shh."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As you wish, my liege.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, my liege."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled and held her left hand b..."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled and held her left hand behind her back as the cameras kept flashing.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Nothing to be done about it now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing to be done about it now."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Efficient, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Efficient, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel shook our hands before helpin..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel shook our hands before helping us into our seats.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Congratulations, Your Majesty. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations, Your Majesty. And to you on your hat, madam."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Where's Pabel, darling? I don't tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where's Pabel, darling? I don't trust these servers to chill my wine to the right temperature."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Why, thank you. I'm happy someone..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, thank you. I'm happy someone in this palace appreciates haute couture."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a look around the hall. It h..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a look around the hall. It had been transformed into a sea of banquet tables, each adorned with silk tablecloths, elaborate floral arrangements and the finest of porcelain. Crystal chandeliers twinkled overhead, so enormous I thought the ceiling might collapse.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a look around the hall. It h..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a look around the hall. It had been turned into a sea of banquet tables, each covered with fine linen tablecloths, tasteful floral centerpieces, and quality porcelain. Overhead, small crystal chandeliers provided gentle illumination.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We crossed the room and took our pl..."
entries.dialogueText: We crossed the room and took our place behind the head table.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Pabel. I'm glad to have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Pabel. I'm glad to have you with me today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The hall looks wonderful.""
entries.dialogueText: "The hall looks wonderful."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Where else would I be, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where else would I be, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It's mostly the work of the commit..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's mostly the work of the committee. I merely advised here and there."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Resources were limited, but I did..."
entries.dialogueText: "Resources were limited, but I did what I could."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A lot of important guests here tod..."
entries.dialogueText: "A lot of important guests here today. Don't screw it up."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Pabel and I sat next to her, she..."
entries.dialogueText: As Pabel and I sat next to her, she gave us an appraising look.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Mr. Adria. I don't believe I've ev..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Adria. I don't believe I've ever seen you sitting down."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sniffed indignantly."
entries.dialogueText: He sniffed indignantly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave me a reassuring smile."
entries.dialogueText: He gave me a reassuring smile.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I would never.""
entries.dialogueText: "I would never."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's *Lord* Adria to you.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's *Lord* Adria to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pabel is a guest at this wedding l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pabel is a guest at this wedding like any other. Treat him with respect."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that you speaking, or the sea m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that you speaking, or the sea monster on your head? I can't tell."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It's called haute couture, darling.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's called haute couture, darling."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Is that so? In that case, congratu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that so? In that case, congratulations are in order."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, pardon me, dear. You have to a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, pardon me, dear. You have to admit your presence is rather unusual."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Congratulations to you on the hat,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations to you on the hat, madam. An original Sarto, I presume?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'm aware of that, madam. Is your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm aware of that, madam. Is your hat an original Sarto?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It's beautiful, madam. An original..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's beautiful, madam. An original Sarto?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother's eyes lit up."
entries.dialogueText: Mother's eyes lit up.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""His last ever. Some say a rival mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "His last ever. Some say a rival milliner murdered him out of jealousy; others believe he killed himself because he would never make anything so beautiful again."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Oh, forgive me, Your Grace. I didn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, forgive me, Your Grace. I didn't notice your arrival."

entries.dialogueText: A string quartet struck up a stately march as the bride and groom made their entrance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and his wife Rita had reached..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and his wife Rita had reached the table. Pabel quickly pulled out their chairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica Sazon approached our table..."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica Sazon approached our table.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Hrm. Thank you, Your Lordship.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hrm. Thank you, Your Lordship."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank you, Pabel.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Pabel."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and his wife Rita had reached..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and his wife Rita had reached the table. Pabel bowed in acknowledgement.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica Sazon had reached the tabl..."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica Sazon had reached the table. Pabel bowed in acknowledgement.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Hrm. Greetings, Your Lordship.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hrm. Greetings, Your Lordship."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Estela raised an eyebrow at the tit..."
entries.dialogueText: Estela raised an eyebrow at the title, but said nothing.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Hello again, Your Majesty. It was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hello again, Your Majesty. It was a beautiful ceremony, wasn't it?"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Mr. Adria, I presume. When servant..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Adria, I presume. When servants are seated alongside kings, it's a sign that change is truly coming to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She bowed to myself and Lucita."
entries.dialogueText: She bowed to myself and Lucita.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She bowed to acknowledge my mother,..."
entries.dialogueText: She bowed to acknowledge my mother, who contorted her mouth into an approximation of a smile.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""All three of Rizia's royal houses..."
entries.dialogueText: "All three of Rizia's royal houses at the same table. Whoever would have thought?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I must say, I've imagined myself f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must say, I've imagined myself facing you many times. In none of those scenarios was I congratulating you on raising such a lovely son."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Life is full of surprises, dear Du..."
entries.dialogueText: "Life is full of surprises, dear Duchess."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother contorted her mouth into..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother contorted her mouth into an approximation of a smile.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""For instance, I've imagined myself..."
entries.dialogueText: "For instance, I've imagined myself facing you many times. In none of those scenarios was I congratulating you on raising such a lovely son."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It was a beautiful ceremony, wasn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a beautiful ceremony, wasn't it?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica laughed warmly."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica laughed warmly.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Then I should congratulate you on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I should congratulate you on the same."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""He's everything to me. I hope your..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's everything to me. I hope your family will take good care of him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm just glad Vina didn't get cold..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just glad Vina didn't get cold feet at the last minute."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are proud to welcome Manus into..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are proud to welcome Manus into House Toras, Duchess Angelica."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope that means you've accepted..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope that means you've accepted that this marriage spells the end for the Sazon legacy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that all the appreciation you c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that all the appreciation you can muster up? My daughter is abandoning the Toras legacy because of Manus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina Sazon. It still feels unnatur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina Sazon. It still feels unnatural to say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is good to have you here, Duche..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is good to have you here, Duchess. The union of our houses by marriage is a mere harbinger of what's to come."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes narrowed slightly."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes narrowed slightly.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I fully understand your decision...."
entries.dialogueText: "I fully understand your decision. The Sazon name is a small sacrifice to make for the healing of our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I understand your feelings. I myse..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your feelings. I myself gave up my name for that of the Sazons."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""But names are a small thing compar..."
entries.dialogueText: "But names are a small thing compared to the long-term healing of our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""That is my hope as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "That is my hope as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Grand Wiseman's sermon moved m..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Grand Wiseman's sermon moved me to tears."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A truly monumental accomplishment..."
entries.dialogueText: "A truly monumental accomplishment for our kingdom and our house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I always preferred receptions to w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always preferred receptions to wedding ceremonies. Bring on the dancing and wine."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not too much wine, I hope.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not too much wine, I hope."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""'Go forth and fortify your house a..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Go forth and fortify your house against the tempests of the world.'"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled fondly."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled fondly.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I assumed you'd taken precautions..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assumed you'd taken precautions to prevent such a scenario."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Forever inscribed in the history b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forever inscribed in the history books."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to Lucita, making an effo..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to Lucita, making an effort to keep his tone lightly conversational.

entries.dialogueText: Vina's shimmering white gown trailed behind her as she and Manus strode through the Grand Hall arm in arm, their eyes still only on each other. Every so often, they remembered to wave to the cheering guests.

entries.title: Narrator: "Vina's shimmering white gown traile..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina's shimmering white gown trailed behind her as she and Rico strode through the Grand Hall arm in arm. They looked like a pair of automatons, smiles plastered on their faces as they waved to the cheering guests.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As they took their seats behind our..."
entries.dialogueText: As they took their seats behind our table, a line of guests formed to deliver their congratulations.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ah, yes, the ritualistic parade of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes, the ritualistic parade of gifts and flattery. If I must suffer through it, so be it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Time to see who still likes me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Time to see who still likes me."

entries.title: Narrator: "Vina suddenly turned towards me, he..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina suddenly turned towards me, her face etched with worry.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I didn't see Aunt Bea during the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't see Aunt Bea during the ceremony."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't think she's going to make..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think she's going to make it, sweetheart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She'll be here. Her convoy probabl..."
entries.dialogueText: "She'll be here. Her convoy probably got held up in traffic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your auntie is cross with Rizia ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your auntie is cross with Rizia right now. But she still loves you."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Hm. All right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hm. All right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Estela leaned over and nudged her g..."
entries.dialogueText: Estela leaned over and nudged her granddaughter.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.dialogueText: "Try and tear your eyes away from your sweetheart while greeting your well-wishers, won't you?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Try and put on a happier front for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Try and put on a happier front for your well-wishers, won't you? You only have to suffer through each other's company for the one day."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Sit up straighter, dear. Don't for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sit up straighter, dear. Don't forget you're the princess of two countries now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina and her new husband both blush..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina and her new husband both blushed.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Sorry, Grandmother.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Grandmother."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Soon to be one.""
entries.dialogueText: "Soon to be one."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Soon to be one, madam.""
entries.dialogueText: "Soon to be one, madam."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel kissed Vina's cheek, then cock..."
entries.dialogueText: Axel kissed Vina's cheek, then cocked an eyebrow at Lucita.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Nothing's set in stone yet, milady.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing's set in stone yet, milady."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel kissed Vina's cheek, then cock..."
entries.dialogueText: Axel kissed Vina's cheek, then cocked an eyebrow at Pabel.

entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry. Who are you?"

entries.dialogueText: "Soon to be one, right, Axel?"

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Axel kissed Vina's cheek.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""If your dad doesn't screw it up, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your dad doesn't screw it up, beautiful."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico rolled his eyes at her."
entries.dialogueText: Rico rolled his eyes at her.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I don't know what you're talking a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what you're talking about, auntie. This is the happiest day of my life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Look at this, Vina. All these peop..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at this, Vina. All these people came to Porte Drazon just for you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Now, Rico. Have more respect for y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, Rico. Have more respect for your grandmother-in-law."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Diplomatic duties call, Your Highn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Diplomatic duties call, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Queen Beatrice was first in line to greet us.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "My word, Vina. You're the spitting image of your mother in that gown."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Vina smiled, her eyes moist.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "Why, I wouldn't miss it for the world. Even the sight of Wiktor Smolak pilfering pastries at the dessert table couldn't ruin this day for me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina made an effort to smile."
entries.dialogueText: Vina made an effort to smile.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you for coming, Aunt Bea.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for coming, Aunt Bea."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Why, I wouldn't miss it for anythi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, I wouldn't miss it for anything in the world."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Duke Reinhart. It's an honor to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart. It's an honor to meet GRACE's newest member in person."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel kissed her hand and threw her..."
entries.dialogueText: Axel kissed her hand and threw her a roguish wink.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""The honor is all mine, Your Excell..."
entries.dialogueText: "The honor is all mine, Your Excellency."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Duke Reinhart. Seeing you in perso..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart. Seeing you in person only reaffirms my belief that Pales would make a fine GRACE member."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel kissed her hand and shook his..."
entries.dialogueText: Axel kissed her hand and shook his head with a grin.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""My deepest regrets, Your Excellenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "My deepest regrets, Your Excellency. Perhaps some time in the future."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Duke Ricardus. I hope being marrie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Ricardus. I hope being married to my niece will keep you out of trouble."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Mr. Sazon. I hope marriage to my n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon. I hope marriage to my niece will keep you from stirring up trouble."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus kissed her hand and grinned."
entries.dialogueText: Manus kissed her hand and grinned.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""No trouble at all, Your Excellency..."
entries.dialogueText: "No trouble at all, Your Excellency. You're more than welcome to dine with us in Iza whenever the Princess graces me with a visit."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""More likely the opposite, Your Exc..."
entries.dialogueText: "More likely the opposite, Your Excellency."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "President Wiktor Smolak bowed low b..."
entries.dialogueText: President Wiktor Smolak bowed low before our table.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Mrff Maphherphy, I schmurr--""
entries.dialogueText: "Mrff Maphherphy, I schmurr--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He picked up a napkin from my table..."
entries.dialogueText: He picked up a napkin from my table and spat something out into it.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Forgive my terrible rudeness. I sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive my terrible rudeness. I should not have sampled a Morellan biscuit before approaching your table."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Allow me to extend my most heartfe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Allow me to extend my most heartfelt of congratulations to the bride, groom and family."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He peered with some interest at Luc..."
entries.dialogueText: He peered with some interest at Lucita, then turned back to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He peered with some interest at Pab..."
entries.dialogueText: He peered with some interest at Pabel, then turned back to me.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I trust you have been enjoying the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust you have been enjoying the gift I gave you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. I had no idea such a simpl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. I had no idea such a simple object could serve so many functions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita suppressed a smirk. Wiktor b..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita suppressed a smirk. Wiktor beamed with satisfaction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel suppressed a smirk. Wiktor be..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel suppressed a smirk. Wiktor beamed with satisfaction.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I treasure it as a symbolic repres..."
entries.dialogueText: "I treasure it as a symbolic representation of the open door between our nations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, it's very good at keeping doo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it's very good at keeping doors from closing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wiktor beamed with satisfaction."
entries.dialogueText: Wiktor beamed with satisfaction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His expression soured as he turned..."
entries.dialogueText: His expression soured as he turned to Rico.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You have my gratitude, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have my gratitude, Mr. President. For your good wishes, and for finally honoring your promise to return my parents' homeland."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice gave me a strange look."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice gave me a strange look.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stared directly at me."
entries.dialogueText: She stared directly at me.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, I very much doubt that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I very much doubt that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stared directly at me."
entries.dialogueText: She stared directly at me.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""My door is always open.""
entries.dialogueText: "My door is always open."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I'm very much looking forward to c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm very much looking forward to collaborating with you. Whether the grand reunion happens or not."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You shan't be living together? How..."
entries.dialogueText: "You shan't be living together? How unconventional."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Mr. Sazon. You seem to be enjoying..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon. You seem to be enjoying success after success lately."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus kissed her hand and grinned."
entries.dialogueText: Manus kissed her hand and grinned.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Winning a parliament majority is n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Winning a parliament majority is nothing compared to winning the hand of your niece, Your Excellency."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes came to rest on Lucita."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes came to rest on Lucita.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You're the gentleman who makes suc..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the gentleman who makes such marvelous tea."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You are too kind, Duchess Azaro.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are too kind, Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am ever so glad that Rumburg was..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am ever so glad that Rumburg was able to help you gain an edge over the Palesians. I am fully confident in your ability to win this war."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Flanked by the Golden Guard and mem..."
entries.dialogueText: Flanked by the Golden Guard and members of Su Omina, an armored car drove us through cleared-out streets until we reached Palas Rezna. It was time for the reception.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Citizens waved Rizian flags and Hou..."
entries.dialogueText: Citizens waved Rizian flags and House Sazon crests from their balconies as our carriage procession wound through the streets of Porte Drazon, flanked by the Golden Guard.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am ever so sorry that we could n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am ever so sorry that we could not do more to help you gain an edge against the Palesians."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your aid was truly invaluable, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your aid was truly invaluable, Your Excellency. I cannot thank you enough."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your aid was truly invaluable, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your aid was truly invaluable, Your Excellency. We'll pull a win from this yet."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice gave her an unusually wide..."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice gave her an unusually wide smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes came to rest on Pabel."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes came to rest on Pabel.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You're the warrior noblewoman I've..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the warrior noblewoman I've heard so much about."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Guilty as charged, Your Excellency.""
entries.dialogueText: "Guilty as charged, Your Excellency."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It's Rumburg's fertile soil that m..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's Rumburg's fertile soil that makes the leaves sing, Your Excellency."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you brought us a gift, or mer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you brought us a gift, or merely come to shoot the breeze?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes came to rest on Estela."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes came to rest on Estela.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""What a unique headpiece you're wea..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a unique headpiece you're wearing, Madame Estela. Was the aquarium kind enough to loan it, or was it dredged up by trawler?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The aquarium, Your Excellency. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "The aquarium, Your Excellency. The proprietor also mentioned that a Rumburgian snag-toothed hagfish had recently escaped its premises. Would you happen to have seen one?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your congratulations are well rece..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your congratulations are well received, Your Excellency. But we must keep the line moving."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for coming, Beatrice. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for coming, Beatrice. We'll have to squeeze in a visit to your new port while you're here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for coming, Beatrice. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for coming, Beatrice. I know all of us wished your sister could have been here today."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That would be splendid.""
entries.dialogueText: "That would be splendid."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice put a hand to her necklace..."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice put a hand to her necklace.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""No need to be so rude, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to be so rude, Your Majesty. Our royal jewelers are putting the finishing touches on your gift as we speak."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I'm not so rude as to have forgott..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not so rude as to have forgotten a gift. Our royal jewelers are putting the finishing touches on it as we speak."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""She lived for such occasions. Alwa..."
entries.dialogueText: "She lived for such occasions. Always ready with a perfectly worded toast."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""All of us. Yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "All of us. Yes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a final curtsy, she departed t..."
entries.dialogueText: With a final curtsy, she departed to the table she shared with her husband and sons.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Your Grace. My sincerest apologies..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Grace. My sincerest apologies for implicating your associates in what I now know was Lespia's terrible crime."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Your Grace. Rest assured I do not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Grace. Rest assured I do not hold you responsible for the rogue behavior of a few of your associates."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I always keep my promises, Madam E..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always keep my promises, Madam Estela."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You do not need to apologize to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "You do not need to apologize to me, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Rest assured I do not hold you res..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured I do not hold you responsible for the failed integration of certain of your countrymen into Rizian society."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I never doubted it, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "I never doubted it, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Were those associates here today,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Were those associates here today, they would forgive you for the unfair tarnishing of their reputation."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Furthermore, I commend you on your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, I commend you on your successful handling of the Bludish problem--"

entries.dialogueText: "What my husband means to say is that the Crown is looking forward to working with you on the safe and peaceful transition of our territory."

entries.dialogueText: His expression turned more solemn as he addressed Axel.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak

entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry we didn't get a chance to speak at the AN, Your Grace. Congratulations on shaking off the yoke of Lespian indentured servitude."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Thank you, Mr. President. I was tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. President. I was truly horrified to learn of their plot to disrupt the Zille handover."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Between Pales' gas and Wehlen's oi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Between Pales' gas and Wehlen's oil, this new South Merkopan alliance the King is initiating will be a force to be reckoned with."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Our partnership with Lespia had it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our partnership with Lespia had its uses, Mr. President. But I look forward to this new era of international cooperation."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I do acknowledge that the aims of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do acknowledge that the aims of GRACE and your country are occasionally at odds."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""But you can rely on the diplomatic..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you can rely on the diplomatic skills of my wife here to smooth over any rough patches."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""And you can rely on the diplomatic..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you can rely on the diplomatic skills of my wife here to smooth over any rough patches."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina squeezed his arm."
entries.dialogueText: Vina squeezed his arm.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""After the safe and peaceful transi..."
entries.dialogueText: "After the safe and peaceful transition of our territory is completed, of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wiktor's eyes gleamed."
entries.dialogueText: Wiktor's eyes gleamed.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Rizia is reclaiming territory left..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is reclaiming territory left and right, Your Majesty! What a glorious era this must be for you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Mr. President. I do in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. President. I do in fact feel that Rizia is entering a new golden age."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do not think of it as reclamatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not think of it as reclamation. We are turning the Rizo-Palesian peninsula into the unified whole it was always meant to be."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing is as glorious as seeing m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing is as glorious as seeing my daughter wed, Mr. Smolak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is truly glorious is sitting..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is truly glorious is sitting here with the people I care about most in the world."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wiktor's eyes gleamed."
entries.dialogueText: Wiktor's eyes gleamed.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Reclaimed territory, new alliances..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reclaimed territory, new alliances. What a glorious era this must be for you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.dialogueText: "More importantly, said changes will be cosmetic at most."

entries.dialogueText: "We're just barely finding our footing after cutting ties with Lespia. Democracy will have to come later."

entries.dialogueText: "We are allies. Let's start there."

entries.dialogueText: "To the contrary. They will improve our populace's welfare, and consequently strengthen the global image of our alliance."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.dialogueText: "Then by all means, carry on. As long as Pales is not expected to do the same."

entries.dialogueText: "My father fell under the spell of a religious fanatic. His actions were not his own."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.dialogueText: "Agreed."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia and Pales have more in commo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia and Pales have more in common than my father ever admitted. I am glad we are recognizing those commonalities now."

entries.dialogueText: President Anton Rayne stepped before me. He was accompanied by a man I vaguely recognized.

entries.dialogueText: "Any friend of Wehlen's is a friend of mine."

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)

entries.dialogueText: "We reformists have to stick together."

entries.dialogueText: "Welcome to Rizia, Mr. Vice President. Please, feel at home among our family and friends."

entries.dialogueText: "Seriously, it's great to be here. You know, I got a nice piece of Rizian gold from Rusty Montoro once."

entries.dialogueText: "Your candor is welcoming, Mr. Vice President. A breath of fresh air in these staid premises."

entries.dialogueText: Hugo breathed an audible sigh of relief as the Sordish delegation left.

entries.dialogueText: "It would be an honor, Mr. Koronti. Please join me aboard the Rizania anytime."

entries.dialogueText: "It would be an honor, Mr. Koronti. Please join me aboard the {Salutations.RoyalJet} anytime."

entries.dialogueText: "Lavish isn't our style here in Rizia. We prefer to spend the fruits of our prosperity on our people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A bit of spectacle here and there..."
entries.dialogueText: "A bit of spectacle here and there keeps the populace happy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Today is about love. Not brazen di..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today is about love. Not brazen displays of wealth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd love to come. It's always good..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd love to come. It's always good to meet a fellow proponent of the free press."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd love to come. I've been meanin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd love to come. I've been meaning to speak with you about how the Sordish press can cover us Rizians more favorably."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is it really so luxurious? When yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is it really so luxurious? When you're as wealthy as we are, these celebrations become commonplace."

entries.dialogueText: The Sordish president nodded approvingly.

entries.dialogueText: He flashed me a toothy grin.

entries.dialogueText: "A true cornerstone of democracy."

entries.dialogueText: He flashed me a toothy grin.

entries.dialogueText: "I'd love that."

entries.title: Narrator: "The Sordish president nodded approv..."
entries.dialogueText: The Sordish president nodded approvingly.

entries.speaker: Anton Rayne (R)
entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""Up to a point.""
entries.dialogueText: "Up to a point."

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti (R)
entries.title: Marcel Koronti (R): ""What a life you and your family mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a life you and your family must lead, Your Majesty."

entries.title: Narrator: "The Sordish president politely nudg..."
entries.dialogueText: The Sordish president politely nudged his companion.

entries.dialogueText: "It's time we adjourned to our table, Mr. Koronti."

entries.title: Anton Rayne (R): ""Congratulations once again, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations once again, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: He politely nudged his companion.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother wore a delighted smile as..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother wore a delighted smile as the Sordish delegation left.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""They're exactly as I imagined them.""
entries.dialogueText: "They're exactly as I imagined them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Well, that went exactly as expecte..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, that went exactly as expected."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a look at the line. The numb..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a look at the line. The number of guests waiting to greet us was lower than I expected.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Jorga Azmal of Derdia came by to bl..."
entries.dialogueText: Jorga Azmal of Derdia came by to bless my daughter's union, heartily shaking hands with Pabel and myself as he did so.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alma Saltana expressed heartfelt co..."
entries.dialogueText: Alma Saltana expressed heartfelt congratulations to both Vina and her new husband.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alma Saltana expressed heartfelt co..."
entries.dialogueText: Alma Saltana expressed heartfelt congratulations to myself and Vina, while pointedly ignoring her new husband.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty Montoro enthusiastically offe..."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty Montoro enthusiastically offered his well wishes and gifted the newlyweds a life-sized statue of themselves made of solid gold.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Alvarez of Lespia di..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Alvarez of Lespia did not join the line but waved from his table, where he appeared to be drinking himself into a stupor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobles from House Toras greeted Vin..."
entries.dialogueText: Nobles from House Toras greeted Vina and Rico in droves, of course.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobles from House Sazon greeted Vin..."
entries.dialogueText: Nobles from House Sazon greeted Vina and Manus in droves.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobles from all three houses extend..."
entries.dialogueText: Nobles from all three houses extended their polite greetings to Vina and Axel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But before I knew it, the congratul..."
entries.dialogueText: But before I knew it, the congratulations were over. Glancing around the hall, I noticed several empty tables.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It felt like an eternity before we..."
entries.dialogueText: It felt like an eternity before we finally got to eat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a look at the line. There we..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a look at the line. There were still a number of guests waiting to greet us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Jorga Azmal of Derdia came by to bl..."
entries.dialogueText: Jorga Azmal of Derdia came by to bless my daughter's union and express his excitement for our countries' partnership.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the father of the bride and the..."
entries.dialogueText: As the father of the bride and the King of Rizia, I was expected to open the feast with a toast.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel had arranged for me to receiv..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel had arranged for me to receive the usual substitute. I raised the full glass in front of me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A new Cantuavo vintage had been bot..."
entries.dialogueText: A new Cantuavo vintage had been bottled in Vina's honor. They'd named it "Her Royal Wine-Ness".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wine production had been difficult..."
entries.dialogueText: Wine production had been difficult in the past years, but the Cantuavo family had still managed to bottle a new vintage in Vina's honor. They'd named it "Her Royal Wine-Ness".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I raised the full glass in front of..."
entries.dialogueText: I raised the full glass in front of me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ladies and gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dear esteemed guests.""
entries.dialogueText: "Dear esteemed guests."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My cherished friends and family me..."
entries.dialogueText: "My cherished friends and family members."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am truly overcome with emotion t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am truly overcome with emotion that so many of you came out to honor my daughter's marriage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When it comes to one's meaningful..."
entries.dialogueText: "When it comes to one's meaningful relationships, it is quality that matters, not quantity. So I am not disappointed with today's rather sparse turnout."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On behalf of the entire Rizian roy..."
entries.dialogueText: "On behalf of the entire Rizian royal family, thank you for joining us on this most joyous of occasions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In this time of war, it is especia..."
entries.dialogueText: "In this time of war, it is especially important for us to gather in celebration of the love in our lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thank God for bringing us togeth..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank God for bringing us together to celebrate the union of these two souls."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the fast-paced modern era, it i..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the fast-paced modern era, it is especially important for us to gather in celebration of the love in our lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am particularly gladdened to so..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am particularly gladdened to so many of our South Merkopan neighbors here. It bodes very well for the alliance we are planning."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In particular, the presence of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "In particular, the presence of our GRACE partners in this hall fills my heart with gratitude."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is particularly auspicious that..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is particularly auspicious that our distinguished guests from Wehlen could be here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I extend a particularly heartfelt..."
entries.dialogueText: "I extend a particularly heartfelt welcome to Duke Reinhart of Pales, with which our kingdom has finally reconciled after years of uncertainty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
