entries.dialogueText: "A special mention must go to Her Excellency Beatrice Livingston, aunt of the bride and Rizia's longtime friend and protector."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cannot tell you how overjoyed I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot tell you how overjoyed I am to see the members of House Toras out in full force."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cannot tell you how overjoyed I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot tell you how overjoyed I am to see the members of House Sazon out in full force."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am proud to extend our tradition..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am proud to extend our traditional Rizian hospitality to our guests from Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wiktor Smolak applauded with gusto."
entries.dialogueText: Wiktor Smolak applauded with gusto.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice nodded proudly, her hands..."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice nodded proudly, her hands folded in her lap.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a round of applause."
entries.dialogueText: There was a round of applause.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd turned to look at Axel. H..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd turned to look at Axel. He blew them a kiss with one arm around his date.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a loud round of applause."
entries.dialogueText: There was a loud round of applause.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Long ago, I promised my daughter t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Long ago, I promised my daughter that she could marry whomever she desired."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A royal wedding is an alliance in..."
entries.dialogueText: "A royal wedding is an alliance in the truest sense of the word."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Like myself and my father before m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like myself and my father before me, my daughter grew up knowing that whomever she married would impact the course of the kingdom and that of our royal house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Today marks the dawning of a new a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today marks the dawning of a new age -- not only for the Royal Family, but for Rizia as a whole."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Providence smiled upon us when the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Providence smiled upon us when the Crown Princess of Rizia fell in love with a man who happened to be my ideal choice of Prince Consort."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew that when the time came, Vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew that when the time came, Vina would do what was right for her country and her future subjects."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was not easy to keep that promi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was not easy to keep that promise. But seeing the look in Princess Vina's eyes today, I knew it was all worthwhile."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel wrapped an arm around Vina. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: Axel wrapped an arm around Vina. They smiled out at the crowd.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The union you witnessed today is m..."
entries.dialogueText: "The union you witnessed today is more than a mere love bond. It is an intertwining of destinies."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina and Rico smiled through gritte..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina and Rico smiled through gritted teeth.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am proud of the Princess for bol..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am proud of the Princess for boldly following her heart, even in the face of pressure to act otherwise."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina looked as if she was about to..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina looked as if she was about to start crying again.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did not choose my daughter's hus..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not choose my daughter's husband. Her marriage was preordained by the heavens."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The new Crown Prince had to be som..."
entries.dialogueText: "The new Crown Prince had to be someone who would keep Rizia strong for years to come."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I am proud that the good name..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am proud that the good name of House Toras will live on in Vina and her descendents."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And while Vina's descendents may n..."
entries.dialogueText: "And while Vina's descendents may not bear the Toras name, I know they shall still carry forth our house's spirit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, the Kingdom of Rizia and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, the Kingdom of Rizia and the Grand Duchy of Pales shall be greater than the sum of their parts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Reinhart, you have been a for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart, you have been a formidable ally and energy partner. I could not ask for a better son-in-law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I trust Princess Vina and Prince C..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust Princess Vina and Prince Consort Axel to bring Rizia and Pales into the future together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sazon, you have been a formida..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon, you have been a formidable political ally. I could not ask for a better son-in-law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sazon, we have not always seen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon, we have not always seen eye to eye politically. But I know you will take good care of my daughter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I trust Princess Vina and Prince C..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust Princess Vina and Prince Consort Manus to bring Rizia into the future. Changes are coming that not even I can imagine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With this marriage, the noble hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "With this marriage, the noble houses of Toras and Sazon will finally be in alignment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rico, you are not only my cousin -..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rico, you are not only my cousin -- you are my friend. I know you shall bear the mantle of Crown Prince with honor and dignity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Ricardus, you have been a for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Ricardus, you have been a formidable political ally. I could not have asked for a better son-in-law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Ricardus, we have not always..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Ricardus, we have not always seen eye to eye. But I know we both care for my daughter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I trust Princess Vina and Crown Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust Princess Vina and Crown Prince Ricardus to bring Rizia into the future while protecting our proud history and traditions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With Vina on the Royal Council and..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Vina on the Royal Council and Ricardus protecting Iza, this marriage is a harbinger of peace and stability for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As Duchess of Valenqiris and Duke..."
entries.dialogueText: "As Duchess of Valenqiris and Duke of Iza, Princess Vina and Prince Consort Ricardus will bring peace and stability to two corners of Rizia simultaneously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, the Kingdom of Rizia and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, the Kingdom of Rizia and the Grand Duchy of Pales shall be strong enough to defeat anyone who stands in our way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This union between the Royal Counc..."
entries.dialogueText: "This union between the Royal Council and the House of Delegates shall bring peace and stability to our government."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard a few discontented murmurs..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard a few discontented murmurs coming from the House Toras tables.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard a few discontented murmurs..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard a few discontented murmurs coming from the Sazon tables.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Loud cheers went up from the Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: Loud cheers went up from the Toras tables.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May your heirs find their own way..."
entries.dialogueText: "May your heirs find their own way in life, unburdened by the expectations the House Toras name carries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And the fact that the Prince Conso..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the fact that the Prince Consort is willing to sacrifice his name to marry Vina speaks volumes about his dedication to the Crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your children will be Torases. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your children will be Torases. Their grandchildren will be Torases. Our house's name shall reverberate through generations upon generations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina shall be the first Rizian que..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina shall be the first Rizian queen not to take her husband's name. Not even my grandmother Lyza could accomplish that feat."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It does not matter what name your..."
entries.dialogueText: "It does not matter what name your children bear. What matters is the legacy you pass on to them -- one of love, honor and integrity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As is God's will, our noble house..."
entries.dialogueText: "As is God's will, our noble house will hold the throne for millennia to come."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we make merry today, let us not..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we make merry today, let us not forget the brave sacrifices made by our troops."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a confession to make. Today..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a confession to make. Today is a celebration of love in more ways than one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Lord foretold that our kingdom..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lord foretold that our kingdoms would be united one day. And lo, it has come to pass."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Toras name is a small sacrific..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Toras name is a small sacrifice to make compared to the glory that is to come."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita gave me a startled look."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita gave me a startled look.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let the joy we share today be a re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let the joy we share today be a reminder of what our soldiers are fighting for."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel gave me a startled look."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel gave me a startled look.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we feast, I invite you to share..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we feast, I invite you to share not only in my daughter's happiness, but in my own."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duchess Lucita Azaro has provided..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Lucita Azaro has provided me with invaluable counsel over the past years. Now she will be taking on a new role: that of Queen Consort."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duchess Lucita Azaro has provided..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Lucita Azaro has provided me with invaluable counsel and support during the war. Now she will be taking on a new role: that of Queen Consort."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I speak of my cherished friendship..."
entries.dialogueText: "I speak of my cherished friendship with my head butler Pabel Adria, recently elevated to the status of Lord."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For those of you who don't know, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "For those of you who don't know, I adopted a dog towards the beginning of my reign. He is the most precious thing in my life. Come here, Bruno!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is no secret that the Duchess o..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is no secret that the Duchess of Montaklar and I have grown close. I am happy to have her by my side on this occasion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Duchess of Montaklar and I hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Duchess of Montaklar and I have grown close. I am happy to have her by my side on this occasion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us not forget to thank the gre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us not forget to thank the great and merciful God for the many blessings we enjoy today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm going to assume that's your ru..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to assume that's your rumbling stomachs I'm hearing. Don't worry, we'll eat soon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As you enjoy this sumptuous banque..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you enjoy this sumptuous banquet, do not forget that it has only been made possible through the benevolence of your king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let the Princess' marriage bond be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let the Princess' marriage bond be an inspiration to us all. I hope that I myself may someday find a love as pure."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Lucita frowning from the Azar..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Lucita frowning from the Azaros' table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Pabel frowning as he stood be..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Pabel frowning as he stood behind our table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guests from House Azaro stood a..."
entries.dialogueText: The guests from House Azaro stood and applauded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As you enjoy this sumptuous banque..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you enjoy this sumptuous banquet, do not forget the thousands of unseen hands who have made it possible, from the farmers who till the soil to the servants pouring the wine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As the chefs bring out our lovingl..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the chefs bring out our lovingly prepared meal, remember that this is a day for unity, not discord."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Saltana stood up and..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Saltana stood up and applauded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Jorga Azmal stood up and applauded."
entries.dialogueText: Jorga Azmal stood up and applauded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The wedding guests broke into titte..."
entries.dialogueText: The wedding guests broke into titters.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The wedding guests broke into aston..."
entries.dialogueText: The wedding guests broke into astonished gasps.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I followed Vina's eyes to the ring..."
entries.dialogueText: I followed Vina's eyes to the ring on Lucita's finger. Her mother's.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The wedding guests broke into laugh..."
entries.dialogueText: The wedding guests broke into laughter as Bruno pranced between their tables towards me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico looked irritated at his dog's..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico looked irritated at his dog's loss of dignity, but gave him a scratch on the ear nonetheless.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I dedicate this day to those who h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I dedicate this day to those who have brought me solace, comfort and unconditional support throughout my reign. You know who you are."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could feel all eyes on our table..."
entries.dialogueText: I could feel all eyes on our table as the guests broke into speculative whispers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Supreme Wiseman Azmal began applaud..."
entries.dialogueText: Supreme Wiseman Azmal began applauding. He was the only one.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter burst out into wild lau..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter burst out into wild laughter. Hugo looked white as a sheet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Duke Reinhart wore a look of pure c..."
entries.dialogueText: Duke Reinhart wore a look of pure consternation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter wore a look of pure con..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter wore a look of pure consternation.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""SILENCE!""
entries.dialogueText: "SILENCE!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We raise our glasses not only to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We raise our glasses not only to the newlyweds, but to a future without conflict."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hall echoed with polite applaus..."
entries.dialogueText: The hall echoed with polite applause.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hall echoed with polite laughte..."
entries.dialogueText: The hall echoed with polite laughter.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I vow that by this time next year,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I vow that by this time next year, Rizia and Pales shall be one!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us lift our cups in anticipati..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us lift our cups in anticipation of the day when everyone in Rizia is free."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us lift our cups to the monarc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us lift our cups to the monarchic traditions which sustain us all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A toast to my wonderful daughter...."
entries.dialogueText: "A toast to my wonderful daughter. Vina, I will always love and cherish you, no matter your path in life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A final toast to love, and to its..."
entries.dialogueText: "A final toast to love, and to its power to build bridges that last beyond our lifetimes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone in the hall lifted their g..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone in the hall lifted their glasses high.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita!""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A proso!""
entries.dialogueText: "A proso!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To Vina and Ricardus!""
entries.dialogueText: "To Vina and Ricardus!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To Vina and Manus!""
entries.dialogueText: "To Vina and Manus!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To Vina and Axel!""
entries.dialogueText: "To Vina and Axel!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina, no matter whom I love, I pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, no matter whom I love, I promise that you will still be the most important person in my life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We shall lead our troops to victor..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shall lead our troops to victory, hand in hand!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I look forward to this new epoch o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to this new epoch of cooperation between House Toras and House Azaro, just as I rejoice in the new bonds my daughter's marriage brings."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The volume in the hall instantly dr..."
entries.dialogueText: The volume in the hall instantly dropped down to nothing. All eyes were on me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I invite you all to cast off the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I invite you all to cast off the shackles of history and tradition. Free your minds, and the rest will follow!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hand in hand, we shall protect thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hand in hand, we shall protect this kingdom and everything it stands for!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I invite you to raise your glass t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I invite you to raise your glass to love, and to its ability to build bridges that last longer than lifetimes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina had a dubious look on her face..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina had a dubious look on her face.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A final toast to the Princess of R..."
entries.dialogueText: "A final toast to the Princess of Rizia. May her beauty, intelligence and grace inspire us all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us lift our cups to freedom. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us lift our cups to freedom. It is coming sooner than we think."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us lift our cups to our golden..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us lift our cups to our golden kingdom and the glorious future that awaits us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone in the hall lifted their g..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone in the hall lifted their glasses high, still somewhat bewildered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All of our Wruhecist guests repeate..."
entries.dialogueText: All of our Wruhecist guests repeated the word. The hall filled with the sound of clinking glasses.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All of our Rizian guests repeated t..."
entries.dialogueText: All of our Rizian guests repeated the words. The hall filled with the sound of clinking glasses.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All of our guests repeated the word..."
entries.dialogueText: All of our guests repeated the words. The hall filled with the sound of clinking glasses.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the others at my table sipped th..."
entries.dialogueText: As the others at my table sipped their wine, I saw grimaces appear on their faces.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "That's not a good omen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A sweet finish to this sweetest of..."
entries.dialogueText: "A sweet finish to this sweetest of days."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It doesn't matter. Nothing can rui..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't matter. Nothing can ruin this day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you say so, Pabel.""
entries.dialogueText: "If you say so, Pabel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're here with me. That's worth..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're here with me. That's worth a little spoilt wine."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked once more at my daughter."
entries.dialogueText: I looked once more at my daughter.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The light from the chandeliers glin..."
entries.dialogueText: The light from the chandeliers glinted off Lena's ring on her finger.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She slouched in her seat as Rico an..."
entries.dialogueText: She slouched in her seat as Rico and Hugo huddled together, speaking in concerned whispers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and Axel were huddled together,..."
entries.dialogueText: She and Axel were huddled together, speaking in concerned whispers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and Manus were huddled together..."
entries.dialogueText: She and Manus were huddled together, speaking in concerned whispers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She slouched in her seat as Rico an..."
entries.dialogueText: She slouched in her seat as Rico and Hugo talked to each other animatedly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and Axel were talking to each o..."
entries.dialogueText: She and Axel were talking to each other animatedly, their full wine glasses all but forgotten.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and Manus were talking to each..."
entries.dialogueText: She and Manus were talking to each other animatedly, their full wine glasses all but forgotten.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knew that it wasn't the wine they..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew that it wasn't the wine they were talking about.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knew she'd remember today forever..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew she'd remember today forever.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knew she couldn't wait to set off..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew she couldn't wait to set off for Valenqiris.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knew she was counting the hours u..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew she was counting the hours until her new husband's departure.

entries.title: Narrator: "Sordland's vice president bowed low..."
entries.dialogueText: Sordland's vice president bowed low to the ground, wobbling slightly as he straightened up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sun was just beginning to rise..."
entries.dialogueText: The sun was just beginning to rise as Hugo and I convened in the council chambers to discuss our strategy.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This is quite the predicament, my..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is quite the predicament, my dear nephew."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""And now she's, what, left me at th..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now she's, what, left me at the altar? Do you have any idea how humiliating this is for me?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He started pacing around the room."
entries.dialogueText: He started pacing around the room.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I'm not an idiot. I knew Her Highn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not an idiot. I knew Her Highness didn't want to marry me. But I assumed you'd convinced her, just as Father convinced me."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""You did obtain her consent for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You did obtain her consent for the marriage, yes? I was under the impression she would be an enthusiastic participant."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This is quite the predicament, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is quite the predicament, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""House Toras has been eagerly antic..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Toras has been eagerly anticipating this wedding for the past year. Now we've got to explain that it's been canceled because the Princess got cold feet?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The entire kingdom has been eagerl..."
entries.dialogueText: "The entire kingdom has been eagerly anticipating our reunion with Pales. Now we've got to explain that it's been canceled because the Princess got cold feet?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's my fault. I never should have..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's my fault. I never should have forced Vina into marriage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She didn't suddenly get cold feet...."
entries.dialogueText: "She didn't suddenly get cold feet. She planned this deliberately to humiliate me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can accomplish this union witho..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can accomplish this union without a wedding. Pales is joining our new South Merkopan alliance, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Postponed, not canceled. There's s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Postponed, not canceled. There's still a chance we can track her down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""People will understand. Women chan..."
entries.dialogueText: "People will understand. Women change their mind all the time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo frowned."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo frowned.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You were 'forced' into such a pair..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were 'forced' into such a pairing yourself, Your Majesty. But you understood that your primary duty was to your kingdom and your house, not your own juvenile whims."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Well, that's certainly not somethi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, that's certainly not something we want to tell the press."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's too late for that, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's too late for that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not heirs to the throne of Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not heirs to the throne of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You were in this position yourself..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were in this position yourself. You understood that your primary duty was to your kingdom and your house, not your own juvenile whims."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's still a mystery to me. Her Hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's still a mystery to me. Her Highness should have understood that her duty was to her kingdom and her house, not her own juvenile whims."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Forcing our Crown Princess out of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forcing our Crown Princess out of hiding and dragging her to the altar? It's not going to look good."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That remains to be seen, doesn't i..."
entries.dialogueText: "That remains to be seen, doesn't it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps none of this matters. If a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps none of this matters. If all goes well, there will be a second Toras heir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina has always been stubborn. Jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina has always been stubborn. Just like her grandfather."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's eyes opened wide."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's eyes opened wide.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What precisely do you mean by that?""
entries.dialogueText: "What precisely do you mean by that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duchess Azaro and I are in love. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Azaro and I are in love. And as of yesterday, she is Rizia's new Queen Consort."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lucita and I were married in secre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita and I were married in secret last night. We plan on bearing many children."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The second I heard of Vina's escap..."
entries.dialogueText: "The second I heard of Vina's escape, I asked for Duchess Azaro's hand. As a contingency plan."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would have thought you'd be happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would have thought you'd be happier. If Vina never returns, you and Rico are next in line for the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She wasn't acting alone. My mother..."
entries.dialogueText: "She wasn't acting alone. My mother and Pabel encouraged her."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I see...""
entries.dialogueText: "I see..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I wish you had consulted your Gran..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you had consulted your Grand Vizier before making such a drastic decision."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But this is good news. Have a chil..."
entries.dialogueText: "But this is good news. Have a child with the Azaro heiress, and our house will happily accept him as the new successor."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Nobody should know about this yet,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody should know about this yet, let alone Duke Reinhart. He may believe you never intended for him to get close to the Rizian throne."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That's even more troubling news.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's even more troubling news."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Grand Wiseman Ignacius' arrest is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius' arrest is still fresh in the public's mind. We can't have it look as if member after member of the royal household is turning against us."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Treason within the royal household..."
entries.dialogueText: "Treason within the royal household.... it will only confirm what the world's non-monarchies already think of us."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What is that worth if our kingdom..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is that worth if our kingdom is an international laughing stock?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Perhaps King Valero's branch of Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps King Valero's branch of House Toras indeed lacks the proper temperament to reign. Yourself excepted, of course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He rubbed his temples."
entries.dialogueText: He rubbed his temples.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What about the Golden Guard? Frami..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about the Golden Guard? Framing this incident as a security breach may smooth over some of the potential damage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's true. Titus and his men shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true. Titus and his men should never have allowed Vina out of their sights."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That wouldn't be fair. It wasn't C..."
entries.dialogueText: "That wouldn't be fair. It wasn't Captain Gordion's fault that Vina wanted to escape in the first place."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't risk blaming the Golden Gu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't risk blaming the Golden Guard. I need Titus to stay loyal to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even Rico?""
entries.dialogueText: "Even Rico?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even you?""
entries.dialogueText: "Even you?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's true that I would have prefer..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true that I would have preferred to see my son crowned Prince Consort. But a closer Toras-Azaro alliance will benefit everyone in the long run."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We'll discuss the full ramificatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll discuss the full ramifications later. For now, we need an immediate response."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""My son will get over it. The news..."
entries.dialogueText: "My son will get over it. The news may even come as a relief to him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course they will. What choice d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course they will. What choice do they have?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Indeed, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This doesn't change our need for a..."
entries.dialogueText: "This doesn't change our need for a direct response to the Vina incident, though."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Royal Family's security is sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Royal Family's security is supposed to be his top priority. But he's lost sight of it since being named to your council."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Royal Family's security is sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Royal Family's security is supposed to be his top priority. But he's lost sight of it since his task force was expanded."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The man obviously wants to be more..."
entries.dialogueText: "The man obviously wants to be more than a mere bodyguard. He may have thought basic security duties were beneath him."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What is his loyalty worth after su..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is his loyalty worth after such a large misstep?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Had his men managed to keep her fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Had his men managed to keep her from leaving the palace, you might have been able to persuade her to go through with the wedding."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was a single individual who let..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a single individual who let Vina escape, not the Guard as a whole."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But who recruited that individual?..."
entries.dialogueText: "But who recruited that individual? Who assured us that every single member of his team was incorruptible? Titus Gordion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a knock on the door. An a..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a knock on the door. An aide announced the arrival of Rico Toras.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Father, Your Majesty. What's going..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father, Your Majesty. What's going on? Nobody's told me a damn thing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I regret to inform you that the we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I regret to inform you that the wedding has been canceled due to a lack of bride."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's been a security breach. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's been a security breach. The Princess has disappeared."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina's gone, Ricardus. It's likely..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina's gone, Ricardus. It's likely she fled the country."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Gone?!""
entries.dialogueText: "Gone?!"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Canceled?!""
entries.dialogueText: "Canceled?!"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Disappeared?!""
entries.dialogueText: "Disappeared?!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was quiet for a moment as he pro..."
entries.dialogueText: He was quiet for a moment as he processed this information.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promise she was excited for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise she was excited for the wedding. Her escape came out of nowhere."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Relax, Rico. We're putting the ful..."
entries.dialogueText: "Relax, Rico. We're putting the full blame on the Golden Guard. Your reputation won't suffer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I tried to convince her. But you k..."
entries.dialogueText: "I tried to convince her. But you know how stubborn she is."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico eyed me dubiously."
entries.dialogueText: Rico eyed me dubiously.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""If you say so.""
entries.dialogueText: "If you say so."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico eyed me dubiously. Hugo gave h..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico eyed me dubiously. Hugo gave him a nod.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't act surprised. My daughter w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't act surprised. My daughter was always too good for you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and Rico both glared at me."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and Rico both glared at me.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""But I understand. You don't want m..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I understand. You don't want me near the throne, I'll assume you don't want Su Omina anywhere near it, either."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""So this whole time, you knew she m..."
entries.dialogueText: "So this whole time, you knew she might run away? And you did nothing to prevent it?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""This debacle is going to cause qui..."
entries.dialogueText: "This debacle is going to cause quite a bit of upheaval in the coming months. You'll forgive Su Omina if they fail to receive the occasional order."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""His Majesty is right, son. We don'..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty is right, son. We don't even know whether Her Highness wanted to leave. This could be a second royal kidnapping."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Nonetheless... this debacle is goi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonetheless... this debacle is going to cause quite a bit of upheaval in the coming months. You'll forgive Su Omina if they fail to receive the occasional order."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He drew himself upright."
entries.dialogueText: He drew himself upright.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Well... thank you for letting me k..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... thank you for letting me know."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Since we all now have the day free..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since we all now have the day free, I'll see which of our visiting guests are up for a last-minute hunting trip."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""But I would never dare to disagree..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I would never dare to disagree with you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a knock on the door. An a..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a knock on the door. An aide announced the arrival of Duke Reinhart.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I came as soon as I could, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "I came as soon as I could, Your Majesty. What's the emergency?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I regret to inform you that the we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I regret to inform you that the wedding has been canceled due to a lack of bride."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's been a security breach. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's been a security breach. The Princess has disappeared."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina's gone, Duke Reinhart. It's l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina's gone, Duke Reinhart. It's likely she fled the country."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Oh.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Disappeared?""
entries.dialogueText: "Disappeared?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Really?""
entries.dialogueText: "Really?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He slowly sat down. The wheels in h..."
entries.dialogueText: He slowly sat down. The wheels in his head seemed to be turning as he processed the information I'd given him.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Funny. Usually I'm the one running..."
entries.dialogueText: "Funny. Usually I'm the one running away from women who want to marry me, not the other way around."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She was extremely enthusiastic. Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "She was extremely enthusiastic. Right up until yesterday."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't know exactly what happene..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't know exactly what happened. All I know is that our Golden Guard failed to do their job and will be reprimanded accordingly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I tried my best. I thought she wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I tried my best. I thought she would come around to the idea in time."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""If that's the way you felt, why di..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's the way you felt, why did you agree to the marriage in the first place?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My cousin drew himself upright."
entries.dialogueText: My cousin drew himself upright.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I will not question your judgement..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not question your judgement, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned and abruptly left the roo..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned and abruptly left the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo nodded in confirmation."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo nodded in confirmation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel crossed his arms and stared me..."
entries.dialogueText: Axel crossed his arms and stared me down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Axel eyed the two of us dubiously."
entries.dialogueText: Axel eyed the two of us dubiously.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We are committed to getting to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are committed to getting to the bottom of this, Your Grace. Whether or not Her Highness is found, a full overhaul of our security protocol is in order."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""A case of last-minute jitters I wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "A case of last-minute jitters I would understand. But fleeing entirely..."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Well. This puts a crimp in our reu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. This puts a crimp in our reunion plans. I'll have to take another look at that alliance proposal as well."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Well. This puts a crimp in our reu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. This puts a crimp in our reunion plans, but I suppose our participation in the alliance you're planning need not be affected."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""An arranged marriage is one thing...."
entries.dialogueText: "An arranged marriage is one thing. A forced marriage is another."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""So you would have married your dau..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you would have married your daughter to me against her will."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Well. This puts a crimp in our reu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. This puts a crimp in our reunion plans. I'll have to seriously think about our other arrangements as well."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Well. This puts a crimp in our reu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. This puts a crimp in our reunion plans, but I suppose our other arrangements need not be affected."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""If you'll excuse me, I've got to i..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll excuse me, I've got to inform the rest of my family."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""So we are blaming the Golden Guard..."
entries.dialogueText: "So we are blaming the Golden Guard for what happened. A sound strategy."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That could have gone better, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "That could have gone better, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle sighed and rearranged some..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle sighed and rearranged some documents on the table in front of him.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'll tell our communications team..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll tell our communications team to get straight on it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'll tell our communications team..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll tell our communications team to go into damage control mode."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""In the meantime, you ought to keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, you ought to keep a low profile, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Announcing your marriage to Duches..."
entries.dialogueText: "Announcing your marriage to Duchess Azaro should serve as a welcome distraction as well. I'll tell our communications team to get straight on it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""At least announcing your marriage..."
entries.dialogueText: "At least announcing your marriage to Duchess Azaro should serve as a welcome distraction. I'll send out a press statement at once."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We wrapped up our meeting and left..."
entries.dialogueText: We wrapped up our meeting and left the council chambers.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's a very good question, Mothe..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a very good question, Mother."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Chilling wine of this caliber is a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chilling wine of this caliber is an insult to the vintners."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's gone. Probably forever.""
entries.dialogueText: "He's gone. Probably forever."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh. What rotten timing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. What rotten timing."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You didn't answer my question.""
entries.dialogueText: "You didn't answer my question."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""He's also the only person in this..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's also the only person in this household who'd appreciate my hat, by the way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and his wife Rita were next to..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and his wife Rita were next to arrive at our table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother leaned over and whispered..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother leaned over and whispered in my ear.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Even chilling couldn't salvage thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even chilling couldn't salvage this batch. Where's your butler when you need him?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Quiet, Mother. Maybe the other gue..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quiet, Mother. Maybe the other guests didn't notice."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Why, this one doesn't need chillin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, this one doesn't need chilling at all. I still wonder what happened to Pabel, though."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo had returned to Porte Drazon f..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo had returned to Porte Drazon for the wedding. We convened in the council chambers to talk about Vina's disappearance.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This is quite the predicament, Rom..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is quite the predicament, Romus."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""First Rico, now Her Highness... I..."
entries.dialogueText: "First Rico, now Her Highness... I don't understand what's happening but it seems our family is falling apart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are no longer the Grand Vizier..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are no longer the Grand Vizier. I don't need your consultation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's my fault. I never should have..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's my fault. I never should have forced Vina into marriage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She didn't suddenly get cold feet...."
entries.dialogueText: "She didn't suddenly get cold feet. She planned this deliberately to humiliate me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Postponed, not canceled. There's s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Postponed, not canceled. There's still a chance we can track her down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""People will understand. Women chan..."
entries.dialogueText: "People will understand. Women change their mind all the time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo frowned."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo frowned.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Well, that's certainly not somethi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, that's certainly not something you want to tell the press."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's too late for that.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's too late for that."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not heirs to the throne of Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not heirs to the throne of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The entire kingdom has been eagerl..."
entries.dialogueText: "The entire kingdom has been eagerly anticipating our reunion with Pales. Now you've got to explain that it's been canceled because the Princess got cold feet?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am still a Toras. And despite mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am still a Toras. And despite mounting evidence to the contrary, I still believe that name is worth something."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He rubbed his temples."
entries.dialogueText: He rubbed his temples.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I know I'm no longer Vizier, but t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know I'm no longer Vizier, but take this as my final piece of advice. This is not only about Princess Vina, but about the Royal Family's standing as a whole."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""After what you've done to Ricardus..."
entries.dialogueText: "After what you've done to Ricardus, you cannot risk this being portrayed as another betrayal from House Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for the advice, Hugo. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the advice, Hugo. But I don't need your help anymore."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""So you are blaming the Golden Guar..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you are blaming the Golden Guard for what happened. A sound strategy."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That could have gone better.""
entries.dialogueText: "That could have gone better."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We wrapped up our meeting and left..."
entries.dialogueText: We wrapped up our meeting and left the council chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I will take my leave back to Monqi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will take my leave back to Monqiz."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Take care.""
entries.dialogueText: "Take care."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You didn't need to join the ceremo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You didn't need to join the ceremony, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's my son's wedding, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's my son's wedding, Your Majesty. Grand Vizier or not, I have to be here."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Congratulations once more, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations once more, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sensing the tension in our voices,..."
entries.dialogueText: Sensing the tension in our voices, Pabel and Rita looked away awkwardly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He raised an eyebrow. He seemed ann..."
entries.dialogueText: He raised an eyebrow. He seemed annoyed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, a string quartet struck u..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, a string quartet struck up a stately march as the bride and groom made their entrance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can accomplish this union witho..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can accomplish this union without a wedding. Pales is joining GRACE, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm happy you're enjoying yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy you're enjoying yourself."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern (R)
entries.title: Petr Vectern (R): ""Don't get me wrong, I love Sordlan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't get me wrong, I love Sordland. But Rizia's taste for the finer things is unparalleled."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guests stood and applauded."
entries.dialogueText: The guests stood and applauded.
